description: Buying-intent category queries for local services and trades such as plumbers, electricians, cleaners and movers. No brand names: the brand under test either appears in the answer or it does not.

brandsNote: Lexicon for competitor extraction. Empty: no lexicon has been built for this vertical yet, and no brand names are invented here. A name matches case-insensitively at word boundaries, using the name plus any aliases. Entries marked ambiguous are common English words and only count in a name-like position (bold, a heading or a list-item label).
